svg.text: DECA DUAL-MODE HYBRID 8-BIT / 4-BIT ALU PROCESSOR — COMPLETE SCHEMATIC
Silicon Reference Verification (74LS181N + 74HC85) & Custom Discrete Core (74HCT283/86/08/32/04/151) with 3-Board System

g.text: • Arduino UNO R4 Minima GND ──► Connected
• Arduino UNO R4 WiFi GND ──► Connected (Native 5V logic reference)
• ESP32-S3 N16R8 GND ──► Connected (Common digital ground)
★ Single ground plane prevents ground bounce during 74181 switching
HYBRID INPUT INTERFACE (PHYSICAL DIP + ESP32 OVERRIDE)
Each input channel features: 10kΩ Pull-down + 4.7kΩ ESP32 Series Override Resistor
CUSTOM 4-BIT ALU DATAPATH (74HCT283 ADDER + 74HCT GATES + 4x 74HCT151 MUX)
Pin 3: A0 ⊕ B0 ──► D4 of MUX 0
Pin 6: A1 ⊕ B1 ──► D4 of MUX 1
Pin 8: A2 ⊕ B2 ──► D4 of MUX 2
Pin 11: A3 ⊕ B3 ──► D4 of MUX 3
Pin 3: A0 · B0 ──► D2 of MUX 0
Pin 6: A1 · B1 ──► D2 of MUX 1
Pin 8: A2 · B2 ──► D2 of MUX 2
Pin 11: A3 · B3 ──► D2 of MUX 3
Pin 3: A0 + B0 ──► D3 of MUX 0
Pin 6: A1 + B1 ──► D3 of MUX 1
Pin 8: A2 + B2 ──► D3 of MUX 2
Pin 11: A3 + B3 ──► D3 of MUX 3
4-BIT OPERATION SELECT MULTIPLEXER BANK (8:1 DATA SELECTORS)
Select Lines: S2 (MSB, Pin 11), S1 (Pin 10), S0 (LSB, Pin 9) shared across all MUXes | Pin 7 (/G) = GND
Controls: Pin 9=S0, Pin 10=S1, Pin 11=S2 | Pin 7 (/G)=GND | Pin 16=5V | Pin 8=GND | Pin 6 (/W)=NC

Controls: Pin 9=S0, Pin 10=S1, Pin 11=S2 | Pin 7 (/G)=GND | Pin 16=5V | Pin 8=GND | Pin 6 (/W)=NC
1) Arduino R4 WiFi | 2) IC12 74HC85 Input A | 3) Voltage Divider (2.2k/4.7k) ──► ESP32-S3
Controls: Pin 9=S0, Pin 10=S1, Pin 11=S2 | Pin 7 (/G)=GND | Pin 16=5V | Pin 8=GND | Pin 6 (/W)=NC
1) Arduino R4 WiFi | 2) IC12 74HC85 Input A | 3) Voltage Divider (2.2k/4.7k) ──► ESP32-S3
★ CRITICAL: 4x 4.7kΩ PULL-UP RESISTORS TO +5V ON F0..F3
• Pulls 74LS181 bipolar TTL outputs (V_OH ≈ 2.7V) up to +5.0V
• Without pull-ups: False FAIL! With pull-ups: 100% Guaranteed MATCH
Goes HIGH (+5V) when Custom ALU output == Texas Instruments 74LS181!
1) Green Silicon Match LED (via 2.2kΩ series resistor to GND)
2) Arduino UNO R4 WiFi Pin A0 (Real-time hardware verification)
OPERATION MAPPING: 3-BIT OPCODE ──► 74HCT151 MUX & 74LS181N CONTROL LINES
IC1 74HCT283 Carry Out (Pin 9 C4) ──► Inverted by IC6 (NOT) ──► Connects to 74LS181 Pin 7 (/Cn) for full 8-bit addition!
ARDUINO UNO R4 WIFI (SOFTWARE GOLDEN MODEL ORACLE)
Pin D2 ◄── Custom ALU Y0 (IC7 Pin 5)
Pin D3 ◄── Custom ALU Y1 (IC8 Pin 5)
Pin D4 ◄── Custom ALU Y2 (IC9 Pin 5)
Pin D5 ◄── Custom ALU Y3 (IC10 Pin 5)
Pins D10, D11, D12 ◄── Opcode Select S0, S1, S2
Pin D13 ◄── Mode Select Switch (0 = 8-Bit, 1 = Verify)
Pin A0 ◄── IC12 74HC85 Pin 6 (Hardware Match Flag)
Pin A4 ──► [2.2kΩ Resistor] ──► Green PASS LED
Pin A5 ──► [2.2kΩ Resistor] ──► Red FAIL LED
GND ──► Breadboard Main Ground Rail (Common GND)
• Top Resistor: 2.2kΩ (from 5V output pin to ESP32 pin)
• Bottom Resistor: 4.7kΩ (from ESP32 pin to GND)
• Protects ESP32 GPIOs while providing crisp, sub-microsecond edges
★ Fulfills entire project with user's exact 2.2k & 4.7k stock!
